stage1.chosen: velocity-based escape direction because it directly addresses the cause of collisions when objects approach from predictable directions, unlike threshold tweaks that only delay failure
stage1.direction: Calculate escape direction as opposite to the object's velocity vector; prioritize moving perpendicular if direct retreat is blocked by static obstacles; reduce _ROLLOUT T to 1.0s in escape checks for conservative clearance; increase _ESC_NEAR_W to 0.9 to focus on immediate threats; set ESC_CLR to 0.3m to trigger escape earlier; ensure escape is triggered immediately when clr_min < ESC_CLR without delay.
